D: A struggling London actress working as an elf in a year-round Christmas shop meets someone who changes everything.
P: Serve the sweets when Kate clocks on at the Christmas shop.
S: Covent Garden cevapi rolls with ajvar
Kate's family roots and the Covent Garden markets

Charred Balkan beef and lamb cevapi in soft rolls with smoky red capsicum ajvar, sour cream, raw onion and parsley. Mix 300g beef mince, 200g lamb mince, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1/2 tsp bicarb and 1 tsp salt and knead 2 minutes. Roll into 16 short fingers and chill 30 minutes. Grill over high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until charred. Split 4 soft rolls and toast. Spread with 4 tbsp ajvar, add 4 cevapi each and top with sour cream, finely diced onion and parsley.
Santa's shop mince pies with orange cream

Buttery little mince pies with star lids, warmed and dusted with icing sugar, served with orange zest and brandy whipped cream. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry and press into a greased patty pan tin. Fill each with 1 heaped tbsp fruit mince from a 400g jar. Cut 12 stars from a third sheet and lay on top. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 190C for 18 minutes until golden. Whip 200ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar, the zest of 1 orange and 1 tbsp brandy. Dust the pies with icing sugar and serve warm.
M: Kate's mum Petra and the family table

Red capsicums stuffed with paprika-spiced beef and rice, baked in a rich tomato sauce and served with garlic yoghurt and crusty bread. Fry 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 500g beef mince and brown. Stir in 100g long grain rice, 2 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp smoked paprika, salt and 150ml water and cook 5 minutes. Cut the tops off 4 large red capsicums, remove the seeds and fill. Stand in a dish, pour around 700g passata mixed with 200ml water and bake covered at 180C for 50 minutes. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove.
W: the Christmas shop where Kate works as an elf

Soft spiced gingerbread biscuits with golden syrup and orange zest, iced with lemon glaze in snowflakes and little stars. Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g brown sugar. Mix in 300g self-raising flour, 2 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon, the zest of 1 orange and 1 egg. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut into stars and snowflakes and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix 150g icing sugar with the juice of half a lemon and pipe on snowflake patterns.
K: Red wine slowly warmed with orange, cinnamon, cloves, star anise and a little brown sugar, served steaming with an orange wheel. Pour 750ml red wine into a saucepan with 200ml orange juice, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise and 1 sliced orange. Warm gently for 15 minutes, keeping it under a simmer. Ladle into heatproof glasses with an orange wheel. For anyone not drinking, warm 1L cloudy apple juice with the same spices.
